arStrings.szText: Every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds, gain {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c}. Gaining {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} spawns {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} Volatile Blood Drop, and collecting it causes it to explode, dealing {c_random}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * (1 + Owner.Main_Hand_Damage_Percent_Bonus) * Affix_Value_1]{/c} Physical damage around you.

You gain {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} and spawn Volatile Blood Drops. Collecting Volatile Blood Drops deals {c_random}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * (1 + Owner.Main_Hand_Damage_Percent_Bonus) * Affix_Value_1]{/c} Physical damage.
